application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Detailed drawings annotated with materials and finished appearance of the various part sections of the exposure roof structure to the new restaurant including through the central roof lantern and rooflight, elevation and section of the new roof plant enclosure in context with parapet wall, elevation and sections of the decorative urns, elevation and sections of the station clock, Fall restraint system to the roofs, internal part elevation and section of new opening at first floor between the shop unit B and new staircase into the restaurant at scale, internal part elevation and sections of the new lift and metal staircase and balustrade and casement windows to unit B at upper ground floor and the junction with the wall insulation pursuant to condition 3 of listed building dated 30th September 2025 (RN:25/05152/LBC)
